newsitem.title: USA: Centennial group raises Nu-Kote stake.
newsitem.headline: Centennial group raises Nu-Kote stake.

text.p: A group including Centennial Associates LP, a New York-based investment firm, said Thursday it raised its stake in Nu-Kote Holdings Inc to 8.43 percent, from about 6.55 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission filing, the group said it bought a net of 397,500 shares of Nu-Kote between October 16 and November 7 at prices ranging from $7.375 to $10.00 a share.
The group holds its stake in the Dallas-based company for investment. Nu-Kote manages a global portfolio of companies in the imaging supplies industry.
